title: 20 Castleview Row, Swords, Co. Dublin, K67CY24
seoTitle: 20 Castleview Row, Swords, Co. Dublin, K67CY24
description:
Exceptional 4 Bedroom, 4 Bathroom Family Home | A1 BER | Solar Panels | Landscaped Back Garden LWK are delighted to present this superb turnkey 4-Bedroom Semi-Detached house to the market for sale.

Presented in pristine condition throughout, No. 20 has been finished and maintained to an exceptional standard by its current owners offering spacious, light-filled accommodation with contemporary finishes, which together with an excellent energy efficiency rating make it an ideal choice for modern family living. 

 The stylish interior, immediately evident upon entry, consists of bright and spacious living accommodation extending to 152 sq meters / 1,636 sq feet over 3 floors and is sure to appeal to families, professionals and first-time buyers alike.

DOWNSTAIRS briefly comprises of bright and welcoming entrance hall with guest WC and understairs storage, large living room featuring a wood burning stove, spacious open-plan kitchen and dining area and a separate utility room. Filled with natural light, the kitchen/diner features upgraded kitchen units, sleek panelling, marble worktop, and a beautiful polished tiled floor throughout.  This exceptional space opens naturally onto the rear landscaped, low maintenance patio area, perfect for relaxing and entertaining. 
UPSTAIRS A stylish carpeted stairwell leads to second floor with 3 double bedrooms, hot press and family bathroom. The exceptional master ensuite is sure to impress and comes complete with walk in wardrobe and ensuite bathroom, with one further double room in the attic conversion. The impressive bathroom suites are all finished to the highest spec, with luxurious carpeted bedrooms providing ample storage.

The property benefits from a significant energy upgrade making it a most attractive option for buyers seeking an energy-efficient home. Upgrades include: solar panels (12), EV charging point, external insulation, heat pump, all upgraded sockets and switches and the property enjoys triple glazing throughout.  

•	Pristine house in turnkey condition
•	A1 Energy Rating
•	Extending to 152sq.m. (1,636sq.ft.)
•	Stunning landscaped patio
•	Converted attic
•	Triple Glazing
•	Solar panels
•	Built 2000

Castleview Row is ideally located within walking distance of local schools and shops at Applewood Village. Bus links to the City Centre and to Dublin Airport include the Swords Express and Swords Village with the Pavilions Shopping Centre within close proximity, offering an excellent selection of shops, restaurants, cafés, and leisure facilities.  The property falls into an excellent catchment of both primary and secondary schools.  Dublin Airport is easily accessible, while the nearby M1 and M50 motorways provide convenient connections to Dublin City Centre and beyond.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
